notes: 02: no remote page fetch; title/metadata entered manually. 03: no auto-collection and no description field, so nothing auto-collected to edit. 04: url/title/tags/notes editable but no description field exists. 07: list shows title/tags/host/notes but no favicon and no description. 10: tags are a plain comma input with no existing-tag autocomplete/datalist. 14: no #tag search syntax; typing #tag matches literally. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesized-group parsing; plain substring match. 16: no quoted-phrase exact match; quotes matched literally. 17-19: only an is_favorite flag exists, not an unread/read-later state or unread view. 20-21: no multi-select or bulk actions. 23: markdown note can be written but is rendered as plain text, no markdown rendering. 24-25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. 29: no bundle/saved-filter entity. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import/export. 32: no user display settings (font size, displayed items).
